pairs.subject: judgeable-spec-authoring
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/template-base.ts:147 The channel template claims per-tick damage and per-second mana drain, but EditorEffect has no period field and the sandbox applies each duration effect's modifiers once, so a 5 s GE_ManaDrain_PerSec costs 8 mana in total and the stated cadence never comes out of running the mechanism.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/template-base.ts:166 In runSimulation (simulation.ts), modifiers are applied once when the effect triggers, and the per-cooldownSec reapplication was removed, so 'PerSec' is a name rather than a simulated rate.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/template-base.ts:125 Template data uses cooldownSec as a DoT tick period (Ignite, DrainBeam 0.5, Poison/Bleed 1), while codegen.ts:125 and simulation.ts:98 treat it as the ability cooldown. The fix kept one reading and did not name a second axis (period), so the DoT templates still contradict that reading.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/TemplatePicker.tsx:61 Template card counts (attrs/effects/rules/slots) are interpolated from array lengths, not typed.

pairs.subject: judgeable-spec-authoring
pairs.evidence: src/lib/catalog/pipelines/items.ts:569 The DPS note's first sentence is interpolated, but this typed continuation adds a flat +17 to the declared 12–18 base and states 22–35. Applied literally, the rule gives 29–35 (avg 32, about 26.7 DPS), so every downstream figure in the worked chain fails to reproduce.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/catalog/pipelines/items.ts:569 Literal execution: 12+17=29 and 18+17=35, not 22–35. Separately, the pfx-2 label at line 375 renders 'Adds 14–17' for a single rolled value of 17.
src/lib/catalog/pipelines/items.ts:422 The typed 'base 5%' contradicts the computed critChance = 0.055 at line 547. totalExplicits: 6 (line 418) is also typed beside the arrays it counts.

src/lib/catalog/pipelines/items.ts:436 The target-attribute list leaves out Accuracy, even though the same dependency list names GE_Implicit_SwordAccuracy and the grant law gives the implicit its own handle. The L3 assertion on 'AttackPower delta' (line 447) also names an attribute that no listed GE targets.
src/lib/catalog/pipelines/items.ts:590 The shared power-budget quantity is assigned to the Economy step on a stated principle, so this step checks internal DPS consistency only.

declined.subject: judgeable-spec-authoring
declined.reason: The context's only file, src/stores/abilitySpecStore.ts, is a Zustand cache keyed by catalog/entity. It holds EnrichedAbilitySpec records but writes no spec prose, counts, rules or worked examples, so none of the seven techniques can be judged on it. A not-applicable verdict would rest on vocabulary like 'spec' that does appear in the file, and the spec content itself lives outside this context (src/lib/ability/spec).
